name: @caotang/desktop-shell
description: Caotang for desktop: the writing studio in its own window.
author: PawCommit Studio

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/mcp-bundle.mjs && pnpm --filter @caotang/desktop build:account
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm --filter @caotang/mcp-server build && pnpm build && install-electron && playwright test
scripts.package:prepare: node scripts/icon.mjs && pnpm --filter @caotang/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @caotang/desktop run build && pnpm run build
scripts.package:win:dir: pnpm run package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.package:mac-arm64: pnpm run package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac-x64: pnpm run package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:dir: pnpm run package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --x64 --dir --publish never
